implementation_note: Primary precedence was recorded before complete annotation. During implementation, diagnostic candidate detection was refined to exclude bracketed numeric time-window intervals in prose and count only disjoint objects bearing case_id or answers; whole-response root JSON is still inspected first. No gold-dependent candidate choice or acceptance change is made. All diagnosed final outputs were separately inspected with AI assistance.
rules: Assign exactly one primary cause from actual visible final content and frozen parser; keep downstream parser flags separately.
Provider refusal/filter has precedence over all downstream failures.
Adapter mismatch is primary only when final-content extraction changes acceptance or answer; representation-only differences are not defects.
Empty means actual final content missing/empty, not a parser-generated missing_response flag.
Use strict duplicate-key-aware JSON parsing, then inspect a sole fence or unique surrounded JSON value diagnostically without substituting it into primary scoring.
Record payload shape and nested violations separately; never choose an alternative using gold or promote a rejected output to correct.
Frozen schema validity determines accepted; refusal/truncation remain failures. Truncation without another earlier cause is an answer/termination violation.
Prompt underspecification is distinct from strict rejection and from a demonstrated implementation defect.
